name: - GDS
fix_description: In _settlementLpMining, reward is calculated using IERC20(pair).balanceOf(_from) which is the instantaneous LP balance. Attacker can flash-loan LP tokens to temporarily inflate their balance and claim disproportionate rewards. Also, transferring LP resets lastEpoch allowing double-claim. Fix: use a staking mechanism that tracks deposited LP rather than balanceOf, or use snapshot-based balance.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC chains multiple protocol-specific steps: initial liquidity seeding, deployment of 100 helper contracts, block advancement, two nested flash loans, repeated reward-claim/withdraw interactions, and final liquidity unwind/swap. Exploiting it requires understanding unusual tokenomics/reward mechanics and state manipulation across many contracts, which is well beyond a straightforward single-pattern bug.
